# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B18

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

According to the deposit README, the power signal adopts a discharge-positive polarity convention for power flow.
Documentation lists interval markers for power yet leaves the exact sample instant unspecified.
Deposit description treats the temperature interval as closed at start and closed at end.
Because the acquisition of current is uninterrupted, the question of sampling rules does not arise.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

Deposit documentation records the current field as a placeholder value.
The data dictionary lists the index recovery method for test index as explicit_index_column, time_segmentation_rule, row_grouping_marker.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

Completeness of the temperature records is verified using: completeness_counter, expected_count_comparison, gap_flag_column.
Documentation mentions a unit attribute on voltage without supplying the unit value.
The data dictionary records that the time channel has scaling set to none.

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B18 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B18.
